summary: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K to clarify redemption mechanics ahead of an extraordinary general meeting (Extension EGM) to approve an extension of its business-combination deadline. The filing distinguishes this redemption from the prior July 23, 2026 EGM event and states that shareholders must submit a new Letter of Intent and deliver shares via DWAC by August 19, 2026, to redeem. No financial terms, premium, or deal specifics are disclosed. This is an administrative SPAC update, not a special-situation event.
